name: Pizzaria Felsenburg
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzaria Felsenburg in Prutz**

Welcome to **Pizzaria Felsenburg** in **Prutz**, nestled in the heart of **Tirol**. Here, you’ll find authentic Italian-inspired pizzas baked in a rustic wood-fired oven, paired with fresh local ingredients. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a vegetarian delight, our menu has something for everyone.

After your meal, take a short stroll through the charming village of **Prutz**, where traditional **Tiroler** hospitality awaits. Don’t miss the chance to try a slice of **Kaiserschmarrn** or a warm **Apfelstrudel** for dessert—perfect with a cup of **Tiroler** coffee.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, **Pizzaria Felsenburg** is the ideal spot for a relaxed yet flavorful dining experience in the stunning **Tiroler** Alps. Come and taste the blend of Italian passion and **Tiroler** warmth!
